content.value_statement: Legacy migrations risk downtime and hidden regressions. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through staged assessment, testing, rollout, and decommissioning.
actual_capabilities: Structures a legacy system assessment with technical debt, dependency, and risk analysis.
Plans dependency mapping, integration catalogs, and business impact prioritization.
Guides test coverage, characterization tests, contract tests, and test data planning.
Outlines strangler fig infrastructure with routing, feature flags, fallbacks, and monitoring.
Defines progressive rollout, performance validation, decommissioning, and documentation steps.
limitations: It provides workflow guidance, not a runnable migration tool or automated refactoring engine.
It requires accurate codebase access, system context, and business priorities from the user.
It depends on compatible agent or subagent workflows for specialized implementation tasks.
It does not replace formal architecture, security, or compliance review for regulated systems.

use_cases.title: Plan a monolith migration
use_cases.description: Create a staged modernization roadmap that keeps critical business functions available during replacement.

use_cases.title: Prepare safer refactoring work
use_cases.description: Identify tests, contracts, adapters, and rollout controls before changing high-risk legacy components.

use_cases.title: Coordinate migration governance
use_cases.description: Align technical risk, business priority, rollback planning, and documentation across migration phases.

prompt_templates.title: Assess migration readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this legacy application and produce a modernization readiness report with technical debt, dependency risks, quick wins, and high-risk components.

prompt_templates.title: Build a migration roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the strangler fig pattern to create a phased roadmap for this system. Include priorities, rollback plans, test needs, and rollout gates.

prompt_templates.title: Design validation coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Define characterization tests, contract tests, test data controls, and performance baselines for migrating these legacy integration points.

prompt_templates.title: Orchestrate end-to-end modernization
prompt_templates.prompt: Coordinate assessment, infrastructure setup, component modernization, security hardening, progressive rollout, decommissioning, and knowledge transfer for this migration program.

output_examples.input: A team needs to replace a legacy payment module without downtime.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a phased plan with risk ranking, contract tests, routing controls, rollout thresholds, and rollback steps.

output_examples.input: A legacy monolith has low test coverage and unclear service dependencies.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends dependency mapping, characterization tests, integration contracts, and priority scoring before implementation.

output_examples.input: A platform team wants to retire replaced legacy endpoints.
output_examples.output: The skill provides a decommissioning checklist, traffic validation period, documentation plan, and cleanup sequence.

best_practices: Start with dependency mapping and risk scoring before choosing the first migration target.
Build characterization and contract tests before changing behavior in critical components.
Use progressive rollout metrics and rollback triggers for every migrated component.
anti_patterns: Do not begin implementation before understanding business criticality and data coupling.
Do not replace a legacy component without tests that capture current behavior.
Do not remove old code until traffic, dependencies, and documentation are verified.

faq.question: What migration pattern does this skill emphasize?
faq.answer: It emphasizes the strangler fig pattern for gradual replacement while legacy and modern systems coexist.

faq.question: Can this skill migrate code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides planning, coordination, validation, and review steps for migration work.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What inputs improve the result?
faq.answer: Provide the codebase scope, technology stack, known risks, business priorities, and required migration constraints.

faq.question: Does it address security during modernization?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes security hardening, vulnerability review, access control, input validation, and OWASP-focused checks.

faq.question: When should teams avoid using it?
faq.answer: Avoid it for unrelated tasks or when the goal is a narrow one-file refactor without migration planning.
